notes: Search budget: 0 of 6 used, since every assigned promoter had a URL. Fetches: 58 of 60. robots.txt: apex.robots returned empty content and usacardshow.com/robots.txt returned 404; both were read as no rules. tickets.txcardshows.com disallows only /admin/, /scan/ and /api/. Nothing was blocked. No phone numbers recorded. Only organizer emails published for vendors are recorded: AlbanySportsCardShow@gmail.com and cardshows@greeniesportscards.com. Past editions use status scheduled because the status list has no held value. Series list specific dates in known_dates; past sized shows are editions. last_confirmed is left out everywhere: TX, Albany and TCG-Kon pages carry only 2025 or copyright footers, and no dated post was found, so the series are rated medium. VENUES: TX series use city level because the organizer does not publish one venue for all dates. Verified 2026 venues, all from ticket pages: Galveston Oct 24 and 25 2026, Moody Gardens Hotel and Convention Center, 7 Hope Boulevard, Galveston TX 77554, 400 plus tables (the homepage said 300 plus); Austin Oct 31 and Nov 1 2026, Hilton Austin, 500 East 4th Street, Austin TX 78701, 300 plus tables; The Woodlands Nov 28 and 29 2026, The Woodlands Waterway Marriott Hotel and Convention Center, 1601 Lake Robbins Drive, TX 77380, 300 plus tables; Lewisville Nov 14 and 15 2026 at NTX Arena, 2401 South Stemmons Freeway, Lewisville TX 75067, over 800 tables (homepage said 750 plus); Lewisville Dec 5 and 6 2026 at the same arena, 400 plus sports tables and 200 TCG corner tables; Fort Worth Dec 12 and 13 2026, Dickies Arena, 1911 Montgomery Street, Fort Worth TX 76107, 400 plus tables; Belton Nov 21 and 22 2026, Bell County Expo Center, 301 West Loop 121, Belton TX 76513, 400 plus tables. Verified weekend hours: Galveston 9 am Saturday to 4 pm Sunday; Nov 14 and 15 9 am Saturday to 4 pm Sunday; Dec 5 and 6 and Dec 12 and 13, 9 am to 4 pm both days. Kids 5 and under free at most TX shows; VIP tiers are extra. ALBANY: hours regular 9 am to 3 pm; two day expo Sat 10 am to 4 pm, Sun 10 am to 3 pm (used for the two day editions). Schenectady hours Sat 11 am to 6 pm, Sun 11 am to 5 pm. Albany and Saratoga use 110 booths (Albany) and admission 5 dollars, kids under 12 free. Saratoga page labels 2026 on May 16, Aug 29 and Oct 3, which fall on Saturdays in 2026; the schedule page gives those as 2027 Sundays, so only the 2027 dates are used. Saratoga Jan 2 and 3 2027 is taken from the schedule page. Syracuse appears only in navigation. Johnstown page says Moose Lodge and the schedule page says Moose Club; Lodge used. Johnstown early bird entry is 20 dollars at 4:30 pm. Johnstown 2027 details are assumed from the 2026 page. APEX: ticket pages give date and city but no venue, hours, admission or tables. Oct 24 and Nov 29 titles say Somerset NJ while the URL says Franklin NJ, so both are recorded at state level. Princeton is in leads only because of the date conflict. GREENIE: Great Northern Oct 2 and 3 2026 is a past edition (200 plus tables). Vendor links conflict between sources for Great Northern, so none is recorded. The Ohio State vendor form is forms.gle/VX2KfG5ZjPjDnb2SA on the homepage and calendar, but the show page gives forms.gle/rrfuyMN9Vystc4Uw8; the first is recorded and should be checked. Medina Oct 31 2026 vendor form is forms.gle/8L9osPC2MNSJ3Cmw9 and is not in the series. Kirtland 2027 dates were confirmed on the Kirtland page under year headings; all fall on Saturdays. Trade nights at Cards in the Land (Chagrin Falls) and Bomber Sports Cards (Broadview Heights) are third party stores and are not recorded. Greenie Medina June 4 2027 hours are TBD on the Friday. TCG-KON: venue names are on /events but no street addresses, hours, admission prices or table data appear on tcgkon.com; tickets are on Eventbrite (not fetched). Event type convention because each stop has guests, tournaments and artist alley. TCG NATIONAL: footer reads 2035, so the page date is unreliable; the 2027 event year is written. The address comes from the page footer and is not labeled as the venue address, so confirm before use. 1,600 plus tables recorded as 1600. Dealers get two passes per table. Dealers set up January 20 2027. SPORT CARD EXPO: the Toronto site lists November 5 to 8 2026 at the International Centre. Ticket prices are given without a currency, so admission is noted only. No table count or vendor pricing is published. USA CARD SHOW: the dates page has no year and no weekday beside any date, and the footer 2026 is not beside the dates, so nothing is recorded; listed in leads only. Vendor form is a Carrd page, not opened.
